name: Living coral growth forms
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. This new habitat-form sheet has NO image input; use the explicit natural/magical form descriptions below, not invented jewelry or clothing. Exactly4 whole natural creatures in separate readable cells, main profile/three-quarter view and smaller front/back or top view of the SAME individual in the SAME restful pose. Complete feet/tails/fins/wings, believable anatomy; no fused feet, duplicated tails, extra limbs or costume. Four legs for quadrupeds, two legs/two wings for birds, six legs for insects, correct fish fin plan. No habitat/branches/water/pedestal attached. No rig or animation claimed. Title "T03-CORAL-001 — Living coral growth forms". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Living coral animals, separate unmounted colony forms with visible base, realistic continuous branches/plate/fan. Gentle rose/cream/turquoise accents, not palace stone carvings. Taxonomy and biology unverified.
